races.paceDynamic: Suspicious Mindz will likely lead from the gates with minimal early pressure, as most prominent runners (Flawless Fusion, New Radical, Gold Inn) prefer to track rather than contest the lead. The sustainable early pace will allow Suspicious Mindz to control fractions through the first half-mile before the field begins to close from the 3f marker. With several hold-up performers (Karrygrant, Templenoe, Prince Andorra) needing to make late ground on soft turf that can blunt finishing kicks, this controlled tempo clearly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Suspicious Mindz sets moderate fractions without early pressure from prominent runners
scenarios.body: The sustainable tempo allows trackers to position ideally and time their challenges, while hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the soft surface. Prominent runners with tactical speed prove superior to deep closers in these conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Suspicious Mindz maintains his lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The controlled early pace leaves him with plenty in reserve for a decisive move, while soft ground conditions hinder the closing kicks of hold-up runners. His tactical advantage from the front proves insurmountable.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and hold-up horses get ideal racing room
scenarios.body: Karrygrant or Templenoe can unleash their finishing kicks to maximum effect when the early pace collapses. Their superior class ratings can overcome positioning disadvantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Victory
scenarios.trigger: If the established form horses fail to fire and an unexposed runner steps forward
scenarios.body: Borora Aura's unknown quantities or Priorstown's lightly-raced profile could produce improvement beyond current ratings. Soft conditions may suit an improver better than exposed rivals.

races.paceDynamic: Dervo Annie will lead from the gates with minimal pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner in this 13-runner field. Glamazon, Spirit Honour, Nephin Mountain and Elora Prince should track in prominent positions behind the leader, but none are aggressive enough to seriously challenge early. The large hold-up contingent including The Love Machine, Personified, Elly Bay and Balance Of Trade will settle at the back, relying on a finishing kick. This lack of pace pressure suits patient hold-up horses who can exploit the anticipated moderate gallop and time their runs late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Setup
scenarios.trigger: If Dervo Annie maintains a steady tempo without folding and the prominent trackers don't apply serious pressure.
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy and unleash superior finishing kicks in the final two furlongs. Patient riders can pick their moment and exploit the lack of early burn-up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If Dervo Annie fades dramatically in the final furlong as her recent form suggests she might.
scenarios.body: The pacesetter's capitulation creates a tactical void that allows prominent racers to inherit the lead without having expended energy in early battles. Those tracking closest can pounce when the leader weakens.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Pace Injection
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group decides to increase the tempo from the three-furlong pole to prevent a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches out the field and makes it harder for hold-up horses to bridge the gap from their rearward positions. Those already in touch can benefit from the honest pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble Home
scenarios.trigger: If Dervo Annie stops completely and multiple hold-up horses get trapped behind a wall of fading runners.
scenarios.body: Poor positioning and traffic problems prevent the best finishers from delivering their kicks, allowing any horse with clear running to capitalise. Racing room becomes more important than raw ability.

watchPoints.text: Dervo Annie's stamina reserves after 129 days off, as any early fade leaves the race wide open tactically

Weather conditions on the day, as any further rain could disadvantage horses without proven soft ground form

races.paceDynamic: Romantic War will lead unchallenged early with Goldrush Kid, Suerte, Lahore Da King and Selective Power settling in behind but unlikely to pressure the pace given the field composition. scenarios.trigger: If Romantic War gets soft fractions and kicks clear before the field responds
scenarios.body: The low-rated leader exploits his 12lb weight advantage and sustains his effort long enough. Hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: D

races.paceDynamic: Baggot Street is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the start without early pressure in this 18-runner field. The prominent runners Polar Bear, Girl Is On Fire, Art Of Unity, Steel Magnolia, Jordan Breeze, and Platino Bianco will sit just behind, but none are natural pace pressers. With 12 hold-up horses including Alnofoor, Jazzit, Never Shout Never, and Apache Star, the early gallop will be comfortable before a cavalry charge develops in the final two furlongs. This sustainable pace followed by a sprint finish heavily favours hold-up horses who can produce their best turn of foot late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swarm Late
scenarios.trigger: If Baggot Street sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches entering the final furlong
scenarios.body: The patient riders unleash their mounts simultaneously creating a wall of finishers. Superior staying power and tactical positioning from the back decides the outcome.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Control
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet applies more pressure than expected and maintains strong positions turning in
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes more genuine, suiting horses who can travel strongly throughout. The hold-up brigade faces too much ground to make up.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Baggot Street Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader kicks clear entering the straight and the chasers fail to organize an effective response
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on the soft ground and sectional advantage. Late closers leave their runs too late on the testing surface.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Baggot Street goes too slow early and multiple prominent runners surge forward simultaneously
scenarios.body: A messy mid-race battle develops with changes of pace throughout. The race becomes a pure sprint from two furlongs out favoring natural speed.

races.paceDynamic: Mc Loven will take them along from the front at a steady gallop on the yielding to soft ground over this sharp 5f trip. Cuban Grey, Amiata, Venetian, Mint Man and Asdana will create serious congestion in the prominent positions, with five horses wanting to track the leader closely. This weight of numbers tracking the pace will create interference problems turning for home, while the hold-up horses Beauty Queen, Sporting Hero, Nezeeh and Aurora Nova will struggle to get clear runs in the home straight. The race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent racers who can secure clear sailing positions early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front runners dominate completely
scenarios.trigger: If Mc Loven dictates uncontested fractions and the prominent pack gets tangled up
scenarios.body: The leader will have too much in hand while the prominent horses interfere with each other. Those tracking closest without traffic problems will pick up the pieces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent racer strikes late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace congestion sorts itself out and one prominent runner gets first run
scenarios.body: A horse like Amiata or Cuban Grey will benefit from Mc Loven's honest pace and kick clear of the melee. The hold-up horses still won't get there in time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horse finds gaps
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack completely collapses into chaos and gaps appear late
scenarios.body: Beauty Queen or Nezeeh will thread through tired horses in the final furlong. This requires the pace to be unsustainably strong and perfect late navigation.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapse benefits closers
scenarios.trigger: If Mc Loven goes too fast early and the prominent horses fold completely
scenarios.body: The entire front division will come back dramatically to the hold-up runners. Aurora Nova and Sporting Hero will benefit from the comprehensive pace meltdown.

With most of the field holding up including quality operators like Justenzia, Lagoon Nebula, and Superficial, the pace will be sustainable rather than fierce over this extended trip on soft turf. The lack of early pace pressure means Radar Ahead can dictate terms, but the large hold-up contingent will be winding up late over the final three furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish, as the modest early gallop will leave plenty in reserve for those coming from behind.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady as expected with Radar Ahead unchallenged early
scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop allows the talented hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks, with the soft ground suiting their stamina profiles. Quality back-markers like Justenzia and Lagoon Nebula can time their runs perfectly.

scenarios.title: Desert Friend Special
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran finds his 2022 form with the tongue-tie helping
scenarios.body: His recent all-weather win suggests he's back to form, and the soft ground suits his staying style perfectly. The 10-year-old gets a significant weight pull and his trainer has an excellent strike rate.

scenarios.title: Battling Siki Stays On
scenarios.trigger: If the lone leader maintains his advantage while the field behind gets stuck in traffic
scenarios.body: The front runner capitalizes on the sustainable pace and messy pursuit to hold his advantage to the line. Battling Siki proves that sometimes the simple option works best.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If one of the back markers gets a dream run through gaps when others are blocked
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as traffic problems allow a swooper to come from last to first. Jet Renegade or Grennanstown Lady time their challenge perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Prominent Survivor Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the seven prominent runners avoids the traffic and maintains momentum
scenarios.body: Despite the congestion, a well-positioned prominent runner like Tim Toe or Good Deal navigates clear of trouble. Superior class tells when getting first run on the leaders.

watchPoints.text: Watch for a cavalry charge of hold-up horses in the final two furlongs as Captain Conby, Joe Cool, and Jet Renegade exploit traffic problems
Monitor if Battling Siki gets too easy a lead early as the prominent runners focus on scrimmaging with each other
Check if any of the seven prominent runners can secure an early position without getting trapped in the inevitable squeeze
Observe whether the soft ground favours the patient types over those who need to use energy fighting for position early
Watch for late gaps opening up on the outside as the prominent runners bunch together on the rail
